name: Sun Yat Sen Nanyang Memorial Hall
scope: The conserved Wan Qing Yuan villa and connected rear memorial hall extension at 12 Tai Gin Road, as documented before the September 2024 conservation closure.

stories.title: Sun Yat Sen Nanyang Memorial Hall

review.notes: Started with the Qualla reference set. Its contemporary hero is share-alike and independent public-domain proof was unavailable for the historic group portraits. For the commonly reproduced early group scene, the bibliographic record establishes publication in 1933. Used NHB written architectural descriptions and a mapped outline, with native elevations.
